verdict.rationale: Publishing fee schedules is a fair question for a state business-filing service, so the axis applies. However, none of the cited Sunbiz pages show any dollar amounts. They describe the filing types (LLC articles, corporation articles, annual reports, fictitious names, reinstatement) and payment methods. The only fee mention says reinstatement requires "paying all associated fees" and gives no figures, so the evidence does not show exact statutory fees published on the service's own pages.
